Nom Bot 2.0 · AI

Nom Bot 2.0 · AI says:

Welcome aboard — happy to walk you through it step by step.

Sign up & trial: When you sign up, we build a meal plan around your dog’s health goals, and you start with a two‑week trial. After that, orders ship every four weeks on a recurring basis.
Set up your account: In your online account you can manage what’s in each order, delivery timing and address, and payment details. Orders bill automatically after the deadline for your upcoming delivery.
Build your dog’s profile: Add your dog on the Pets page, including age, weight, and activity level (Average, Active, or Athlete). This helps us calculate the right portion sizes.
Check portions & feeding guide: Under your dog’s profile you’ll see their recipes, portions, and a Feeding Guide with up‑to‑date instructions so you always know how much to serve.
Transition to Nom Nom food: To avoid tummy upset, start by mixing about 25% Nom Nom with 75% current food for days 1–2, then 50/50 for days 3–4, 75% Nom Nom for days 5–6, and reach 100% Nom Nom on day 7. If using it as a topper, reduce the old food so you’re not overfeeding.
Keep info updated: If your dog’s weight or activity changes, update their profile and save changes so we can adjust portions. Just make sure any changes are made before your order deadline.
Optional: loop in your vet: From the Pets page you can send your dog’s Nom Nom nutrition info directly to your veterinarian by entering their name and email.
Adding another dog later: You can add more pups from the Pets page and build each one a separate meal plan; just be aware that adding or removing dogs changes your subscription cost.

In short: create an account, build your dog’s profile and plan, start the two‑week trial, follow the 7‑day transition schedule, and use your Feeding Guide and account settings to keep everything dialed in for your pup.
